name: image-mousetrail-small
blurb: Compact image trail following cursor movement.
description: Container with smaller trail images following cursor movement. Same component as default but with reduced image dimensions for subtle effects.
use_when: Interactive sections where image trails should be less prominent or space-constrained.
avoid_when: Mobile-only experiences or when larger visual impact is needed.
a11y: Trail images are decorative overlays; semantic content via children prop.
